reports.description:
Email appears to be encrypted, it is not, it is simple obfuscation using excess characters that are rendered transparently at 0px when viewed. Run a regex to delete the following patterns: <font style=color:transparent;font-size:0px;>*</font> and the plaintext is revealed. 
_x000D_
An excerpt, which is surprisingly good advice coming from a scam..._x000D_
My advice: keep changing all your passwords frequently.
